publication.edition: English translation (revised); text c. 3rd century BCE

verification.verification_notes: Confirmed the Zhuangzi is a Warring States-era Chinese philosophical text mixing argument, dialogue, parable and paradox; the 'Butterfly Dream' closes the 'On the Equality of Things' chapter and turns on a distinction between dream and waking.

limitations: Classical Chinese wordplay and puns are only partially recoverable in translation.
